en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a funeral procession in a European city street. Uniformed men in long coats carry a large, dark-draped coffin while soldiers or guards line the street and civilians watch. The background features multi‑story stone buildings with shopfronts; large commercial signs in a Finno‑Ugric–looking language are visible above the ground-floor shops.
